lines: Tch-tch-tch! I made a cool TM!
reward: It can cause all kinds of fun!
Tch-tch-tch! That's the sound of a metronome! It tweaks your Pokemon's brain into using moves it doesn't know!

lines: Hah! I am Blaine! I am the Leader of Cinnabar Gym!
battle: My fiery Pokémon will incinerate all challengers! Hah! You better have Burn Heal!
I have burnt out! You have earned the Volcano Badge!
Fire Blast is the ultimate fire technique! Don't waste it on water Pokémon!
reward: Here, you can have this too!
TM38 contains Fire Blast! Teach it to fire-type Pokémon! Charmeleon or Ponyta would be good bets!

lines: Brendan talks about you very often; you seem to be a big motivator for him.
Oh right! I'm May. Brendan and I both come from Hoenn.
battle: Well, I could use a warm-up before I face Blaine.
I may as well see how skilled you are myself! I see why Brendan looks up to you now.
reward: I don't know if we'll bump into each other again, so please, have this.
